youtube.title: The Man Who Stopped on the Road
youtube.description:
Good Samaritan story explained: a man asks 'who is my neighbour?' and gets a story about a road, two people who walked past, and one who stopped.

This is the parable Jesus told in Luke 10:25-37, retold in plain words in about four minutes. A traveller is left by the roadside on the way down to Jericho. A priest and a Levite cross to the other side. A Samaritan, someone the listeners looked down on, stops, carries him to an inn and pays for his care. Then comes the question back to the lawyer: which of the three was the neighbour?

00:00 The question
00:33 The road
01:12 The other side
01:51 The Samaritan
02:32 The inn
03:01 Two coins
03:28 Which one

Question for the comments: Who is on the other side of your road this week?

This is a retelling of a parable, shown as an animated story with invented drawings. Voice and visuals in this video are AI-generated. Characters and events are fictional.
Music: original score made for this channel.
